Magnesium sulfate is a soluble solid which is formed when insoluble magnesium oxide reacts with
dilute sulfuric acid.
Which method is used to prepare solid magnesium sulfate?
A
Excess sulfuric acid is reacted with magnesium oxide. The mixture is evaporated to dryness.
Excess sulfuric acid is reacted with magnesium oxide. The precipitate is filtered, washed
B
and dried.
Sulfuric acid is reacted with excess magnesium oxide. The mixture is filtered and the filtrate is
C
evaporated to dryness.
Sulfuric acid is reacted with excess magnesium oxide. The precipitate is filtered, washed
D
and dried.

options.label: A
options.text: Excess sulfuric acid is reacted with magnesium oxide. The mixture is evaporated to dryness.
